Plantigrade_Biped_Legs.description: The Plantigrade_Biped_Legs are sturdy, human-like appendages that provide a grounded gait and unmatched balance, enhancing agility and strength with every step. Their design allows for seamless traversal across varied terrains, granting users an innate sense of power and stability.

Webbed_Hopping_Legs.description: Webbed Hopping Legs, a frog-like appendage with delicate, gossamer webs, grants swift hops and agile swims, enhancing mobility and evoking the grace of a leaping amphibian.

Scaled_Reptilian_Legs.description: Scaled Reptilian Legs: These sinuous appendages, akin to a lizard's sleek limbs, grant swift movement and aquatic prowess, enhancing your speed with a grace both deadly and mesmerizing.

Columnar_Stout_Legs.description: The Columnar Stout Legs are massive, pillar-like limbs that exude a dense, earthy aura. With elephantine grace and incredible stability, they grant unmatched fortitude and speed to those who wield them.
